Lennox (NYSE:LII) is a leading worldwide provider of climate control solutions for air conditioning,
heating, and refrigeration. We have built our business on a heritage of integrity and innovation
dating back to 1895.

unprecedented whole-home comfort system that seamlessly and intelligently works together to stay
finely tuned to your home and deliver consistently clean, perfect air.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is computing investment different from crypto mining?

Computing investment is about renting computing power for real-world use cases like AI training and
scientific computing. Revenue comes from enterprise clients' leasing fees. This is fundamentally
different from crypto mining — our revenue model is based on real commercial demand and long-term
contracts, not token price fluctuations.

What is the minimum investment threshold?

We offer tiered plans starting from ¥99,000 for the Starter. The Pro plan suits high-net-worth
clients, while the Enterprise plan is customized to your specific needs. All plans provide
transparent return expectations and risk disclosures.

How is my computing asset secured?

All computing equipment is deployed in our T3+ certified data center with 24/7 security, fire
suppression, and climate control systems. We also provide asset insurance, real-time monitoring
dashboards, and regular audit reports. Contracts clearly define asset ownership to ensure your
rights are legally protected.

How are returns calculated and distributed?

Returns are calculated based on the actual rental of your hosted computing resources, accumulated
daily and settled monthly. You can monitor utilization rates, revenue details, and settlement
progress in real-time through your dedicated dashboard. We offer bank transfers, USDT, and other
settlement methods.

Can I visit the data center in person?

Absolutely. We organize regular customer tours where you can see the scale and operational standards
of our super factory firsthand. Professional plan and above customers enjoy complimentary quarterly
visits. Starter plan customers can schedule paid visits. Please contact your account manager in
advance to arrange your trip.

## Computing Power Is an Asset. Now Is the Time.

The AI wave is here, and the demand for computing power only grows.
Contact us

# A History of Innovation and… the pursuit of Perfect Air

Lennox (NYSE:LII) is a leading worldwide provider of climate control solutions for air conditioning,
heating, and refrigeration. We have built our business on a heritage of integrity and innovation
dating back to 1895.

## The Ultimate System for Perfect Air

The Ultimate Comfort System™ combines the best of the Dave Lennox Signature® Collection to create an
unprecedented whole-home comfort system that seamlessly and intelligently works together to stay
finely tuned to your home and deliver consistently clean, perfect air.

Perfect air is about more than just how it feels, but what it contains. Lennox offers a range of
advanced air purification, filtration, humidity control and ventilation systems to help ensure the
air inside your home is as clean, healthy and comfortable as you'd like it to be.

regulate humidity levels and effectively eliminate contaminants, Lennox HVAC solutions create a
healthier workspace for your team and customers.

## Our AI Lab & Showroom is officially open

On May 20, the BrainBox AI Trane Technologies AI Lab & Showroom opened in Montreal, Canada — a
permanent space designed to develop and demystify advanced artificial intelligence (AI) in HVAC.
Driving the frontier of AI and innovation, the AI Lab delivers cutting-edge solutions that
accelerate energy optimization and sustainability impact for our customers, communities, and the
built environment.

[Learn more about our AI Lab][131]

## Reimagining data center cooling for a more sustainable digital future

At Trane Technologies, we challenge the idea that data centers and sustainability are at odds and
can help redefine data center design through smarter cooling, energy management, digital solutions
and scalable thermal strategies. Our portfolio spans air cooling, liquid cooling and modular
infrastructure, backed by services that can improve resiliency through proactive monitoring,
predictive insights and maximized performance.

[Explore our data center solutions][132]

and strengthen resilience.

scales.

politician who combined a forward-looking vision with humanity and a strong sense of duty. A

# Raw Materials Supplier USA

Bisley International deploys a holistic understanding of markets, technical insight and logistics
excellence to build durable strategies which unite the world’s best raw material producers with
industrial consumers in North America. We supply and distribute a wide range of specialty chemicals,
minerals, raw materials and more...

[About Us][55] [View Products][56]

WHAT WE DO

## Industry experts & the trusted chemical raw material supplier in the USA & Worldwide

Established in Houston, Texas, USA, Bisley International draws on the global reach of the
multinational Bisley Group, with 65 years of experience in marketing and as distributor of chemical
products and high quality industrial raw materials throughout Asia Pacific, Oceania and the Middle
East.

[Contact Sales][57] [Visit Bisley Group Australia][58]

As international raw materials and chemical suppliers, our products range from Fine Industrial
Chemicals for highly specialised applications, to bulk raw materials delivered in shiploads to major
regional manufacturers.

Our goal is to provide a complete package of technically outstanding products, supported by
proficient, responsive staff and first class logistics to a range of industries.

**Our Value Proposition**
We pride ourselves in our ability to add value and create synergies for our supplier and customer
partners.

**Our Guarantees**
We believe it’s important to focus on what is most valuable to our customers and really stand by
this - for the long term.

**Our strategic network…**
Our experienced team of logistics experts are able to track our cargo movements from factories
across the globe right to our customer’s doorstep, whilst keeping all stakeholders informed with up
to date information.

Bisley International is supported by the Bisley Group, with headquarters in Sydney, Australia.
Global chemical sourcing is also supported through our network of offices in the UAE, Bangkok,
Singapore, Malaysia, New Zealand, Indonesia and USA.

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

### We have the products and expertise you need for your next building project - no matter where you
### are.

[Lundhs Emerald® tile and countertop - photo by Morton Rakke]

At CP Supply, we pride ourselves in having knowledgeable staff who specialize in building materials
quality and performance - from selecting the right product for your application to providing helpful
advice about installation techniques. Since our inception, we have developed an expansive network of
international suppliers, which allows us to source unique specialty items at affordable prices. We
understand the importance of completing a project on time within budget constraints, and that’s why
we go above and beyond to ensure all orders are fulfilled quickly without compromising quality.

[Siparila wood siding on Lykke Condos in Bozeman, MT supplied by CP Supply]

Our commitment to excellence makes us an ideal partner for professional builders who require only
the best materials for their projects. CP Supply has become a trusted name in its industry by
delivering unparalleled service and ethics-driven sustainability practices. Connect with us today to
see how we can help your next building project succeed.
* [Siparila Extra Wide Topcoat®-W exterior wood siding on home designed and built by Anne and Pete
  Louhisola in Masku, Finland]
  
  ## SIPARILA - wood siding
  
  Transform your design projects with Siparila wood products. This globally renowned company has
  crafted premium-grade thermally modified exterior and designer interior wood siding, certified by
  the PEFC for sustainability and quality assurance. Their meticulous craftsmanship adds a unique
  touch of natural beauty to every project.
  
  [ learn more ][16]
* [LUNDHS® REAL STONE - Emerald® tile and kitchen countertop, photo courtesy of Morten Rakke for
  LUNDS®]
  
  ## LUNDHS® REAL STONE - countertops and tile
  
  Lundhs Real Stone creates countertops and tile from larvikite and anorthosite crafted by nature
  300 million years ago in Norway. Lundhs products are ISO-14001 certified, have numerous FIRA
  certifications, and are naturally resistant to high heat, frost, staining, abrasion, water, and
  more. Explore Lundhs' unrivaled collection of feldspar crystal surfaces –
  
  [ learn more ][17]
* [Innotech Windows used in Bozeman's Lykke Condos]
  
  ## Innotech - windows and doors
  
  Innotech Windows and Doors are Energy Star® qualified, PHI certified, BUILT GREEN® certified, and
  LEED® certified. Innotech's energy-efficient designs–such as the options with "tilt + turn"
  operation–have revolutionized the industry in high-security and high-performance windows and
  doors. Learn more about using Innotech products in your building projects.
  
  [ learn more ][18]
* [HELVEX Plumbing Fixtures used in Bozeman's Lykke Condos]
  
  ## HELVEX - plumbing fixtures
  
  Established over 25 years ago, Helvex is known for its exceptional plumbing fixtures and quality
  assurance. Helvex continues revolutionizing industry standards and is respected worldwide for its
  water-conserving fixtures.
  
  [ learn more ][19]
* [Haro wood flooring - oak pure white Sauvage brushed - photo courtesy of Haro]
  
  ## HARO Flooring
  
  For over 150 years, HARO has revolutionized the flooring world with innovative, healthier,
  sustainable solutions. Drawing on their years of family-owned experience in Germany's
  manufacturing industry, they've produced award-winning products proudly certified by CE label Blue
  Angel and sourced from PEFC-certified timber.

# a Greener Future

[**Call Us Now** ][9]

Home

## **Welcome to Eco Packer!**

## India's Leading Manufacturer and Supplier of Eco-Friendly Packaging Materials, Committed to
## Sustainable Packaging Solutions with State-of-the-Art Facilities in Bangalore, Chennai,
## Coimbatore, and Erode

[Eco Packer]

Eco Packer is India's leading manufacturer and supplier of eco-friendly packaging materials,
headquartered in Bangalore. With state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities strategically located in
Bangalore, Chennai, Coimbatore, and Erode, we are committed to delivering sustainable packaging
solutions that meet the highest industry standards. Our extensive range of products is designed to
cater to diverse industries, ensuring that businesses can embrace environmentally responsible
practices without compromising on quality.

## Our Commitment to Sustainability

At Eco Packer, sustainability is at the core of everything we do. We believe that packaging should
protect not only the products but also the planet. Our eco-friendly packaging materials are designed
to reduce the environmental impact, minimize waste, and contribute to a circular economy. By
choosing Eco Packer, you are not only opting for high-quality packaging but also supporting a
greener future.

## Benefits of Our Eco-Friendly Packaging

Our eco-friendly packaging solutions offer a wide range of benefits, ensuring that your business can
maintain its commitment to sustainability without sacrificing performance:
* **Environmentally Safe:** Made from biodegradable and compostable materials, our packaging
  decomposes naturally, leaving no harmful residues.
* **High Durability:** Despite being eco-friendly, our packaging materials are designed to be strong
  and durable, providing excellent protection for your products.
* **Customizable Solutions:** We offer tailored packaging solutions to meet the unique needs of your
  business, whether it's for retail, e-commerce, or industrial applications.
* **Cost-Effective:** Our sustainable packaging is not only good for the environment but also
  cost-effective, helping you reduce waste management expenses.

## Applications of Our Packaging Solutions

Eco Packer's packaging materials are versatile and can be used across various industries. Whether
you are in food and beverage, retail, healthcare, or industrial sectors, our solutions are designed
to meet your specific needs:
* **Food & Beverage:** Keep your products fresh and safe with our food-grade biodegradable
  packaging.
* **Retail:** Enhance your brand's sustainability image with our compostable and recyclable retail
  packaging.
* **E-commerce:** Ensure your products reach customers in perfect condition with our durable and
  eco-friendly packaging for e-commerce.
* **Healthcare:** Protect sensitive medical supplies with our sterile and environmentally safe
  packaging options.

## State-of-the-Art Manufacturing Facilities

Eco Packer's cutting-edge manufacturing facilities in Bangalore, Chennai, Coimbatore, and Erode are
equipped with the latest technology to ensure the highest quality production. Our plants are
designed to maximize efficiency while minimizing environmental impact, using energy-efficient
processes and sustainable materials. This allows us to deliver top-notch packaging solutions while
reducing our carbon footprint.

## Why Choose Eco Packer?

Choosing Eco Packer means partnering with a company that prioritizes sustainability without
compromising on quality. Our commitment to innovation, combined with our extensive industry
expertise, makes us the ideal partner for businesses looking to make a positive environmental
impact. With our wide range of eco-friendly packaging options and customizable solutions, we are
here to help you meet your sustainability goals.

## Get in Touch with Us

Ready to make the switch to sustainable packaging? Contact Eco Packer today to learn more about our
products and services. Our team of experts is here to help you find the perfect packaging solutions
for your business. Together, we can build a greener future.

## Energy Efficiency Solutions Already Exist

They are affordable, scalable and ready for investment. Now is the moment to act.

**The Energy Efficiency Movement is the** **global network **driving** awareness, adoption and
development of energy efficiency solutions **across all industrial sectors.

The Energy Efficiency Movement empowers industry to adopt energy efficiency at scale and accelerate
progress toward net zero.

 

 

1/3

of the CO2 cuts we need can be delivered by energy efficiency.

Reference : IEA, 2024

We help companies move **from interest to action** by making energy efficiency knowledge,
implementation examples, training and partners easier to find and use.

For companies, energy efficiency can **lower operating costs, reduce exposure to energy price
****volatility, improve resilience** and cut emissions using solutions that already exist

By joining the Energy Efficiency Movement, **Movers** have a platform to **communicate** their
energy efficiency needs, **fostering** a collaborative environment that drives impactful change and
long-term **profitability**.

[Join now!][32]

15%

of the industry costs can be slashed through energy efficiency within two years.

Reference : IEA, 2024

## Why Should Your Company Join The Network?

LEARN

**Find practical guidance to identify energy efficiency opportunities, understand available
solutions and take the first steps toward implementation.**

[Shaking hands]

COLLABORATE

**Connect with organizations working on similar challenges, exchange implementation experience and
identify opportunities to accelerate action together.**

BUILD SKILLS

**Build the technical, operational and management capabilities needed to identify, implement and
maintain energy efficiency solutions.**

## Energy Efficiency Investment Report 2026

The 2026 edition of our survey shows that energy efficiency is no longer just a sustainability
topic: 98% of organizations are at least planning to invest in energy efficiency, driven by rising
energy costs and the need for greater resilience and competitiveness.

[Download report »][33]

### ****Celebrating 5 years of the Energy Efficiency Movement**

In this anniversary video, Linda Pålsson shares why collaboration, collective action, and energy
efficiency are more important than ever to build a resilient and competitive industrial future.

## About Fluor

Through our people, projects and partnerships, Fluor connects businesses and communities to advance
economies and employment. We create choice and opportunity on a local and global scale.

Building a better world is our purpose. We care deeply about safety and seek to drive quality and
efficiency in all that we do. We behave **ethically**, inclusively and responsibly for a brighter
future.

We support our clients in solving critical challenges. We operate throughout the project lifecycle,
from conceptual design, engineering, procurement and construction to the operations and maintenance
of facilities.

Clients, partners and communities trust Fluor because we are here for the long term – delivering
successful projects of both scale and significance for more than a century. From the spark of an
idea to a project's completion, our nearly 27,000 colleagues in more than 60 locations around the
globe provide professional and technical solutions with world-class expertise.

## Making connections since 1945.

**Fronius is a global corporation specializing in **welding technology, photovoltaics, and battery
charging technology.**

Since **1945**, we have been developing solutions that stand for **quality, reliability, and
durability.** With around 6,500 employees in **37 subsidiaries,** we focus on innovation and
sustainability in order to provide our customers around the world with the best possible products
and services.

Guided by the principle of “Connecting what matters”, we connect people, materials, and energy to
build a **safe and sustainable world.**

Fronius Solar & Energy
Electricity is the thread that binds our business and our world together. By focusing on energy
sector integration, our solutions connect the sun with the grid, the grid with mobility, and energy
systems with efficiency.

Fronius Welding
Our welding technology is designed to forge unbreakable bonds between metals for decades to come.
[Discover Fronius Welding][4]

## Our new product highlights

### Reserva—the Fronius storage solution

Use solar energy around the clock with the Fronius Reserva. The high-voltage battery with DC
coupling ensures a highly efficient energy transfer. Thanks to its modular capacity of 6.3 to 15.8
kWh, the Reserva can be flexibly adapted to your needs. Designed to work seamlessly with Fronius
hybrid inverters, it slots perfectly into your PV system. Your data remains secure on European
servers, while our proven service and support network is always there for you.

[Learn more about the Fronius Reserva][7]
[Fronius Reserva]

### Fronius Fortis—the next-gen manual MIG/MAG welding machine

Welding tasks are often a challenge, especially for small and medium-sized companies. Some of the
tasks change on a daily basis, as do the required welding processes. This calls for a welding
machine that can be adapted perfectly to these dynamic conditions.

[Learn more about the Fronius Fortis][8]
[Fronius Fortis]

resin absorption. Its uncalendered structure provides enhanced porosity, allowing deep impregnation

Design principles. We integrate these standards into our designs to ensure that your building not
only meets but exceeds energy efficiency expectations. By considering factors such as insulation,
air sealing, lighting, and HVAC systems, we create holistic solutions that optimise energy use and
reduce environmental impact.

### Innovation Sustainability

The prevailing business environment in the world has made it imperative for the businesses and
startups to focus on innovation to gain an edge and advantage over their peer organizations in the
industry. With the ever-increasing cut-throat competition in various business spheres, it is
critical for both large scale organizations and startups to keep on bringing about innovations that
can sustain in the market. At the Institute of Advanced Materials, we help companies that want to
keep on developing and building on their innovation ability and quotient. We help organizations
develop sustaining innovations that help them bring about great results and impact in their
industry.

### Making Change That Matters

At Institute of Advanced Materials, we are committed to making change that actually matters for
society. We use our network of technocrats and researchers to recognize the areas that are crucial
for human existence along with the ones that hold true potential for development and enhancement.
All the work that we do, ranging from global consultancy, industrial training to research and
development is aimed at bringing out some positive change and making a significant difference to the
lives of people.

## Who we are

IREC is a public research centre within the CERCA system, founded in 2008 and dedicated to research,
development, innovation and demonstration in sustainable energy.

Our work spans the full scope of the energy transition, from fundamental science to applied
research, with the aim of generating knowledge that is relevant to industry, public administrations
and society. Through collaboration with research groups, institutions and companies, we help drive
the energy transition and strengthen the role of science in building a cleaner and more resilient
future.

## Building better around the world

Family-run and globally driven, the Knauf Group is a trusted building materials leader that
simplifies every phase of construction offering comprehensive solutions and ensuring quality
assurance.

Our renowned brands reach more than 90 countries, with 85 raw materials processing plants and 320
manufacturing sites. Led by Jörg Kampmeyer, Dr Uwe Knotzer, Dr Kristin Neumann and Murat Akyildiz,
we continue to expand our varied product portfolio, made possible by more than 43,500 dedicated
employees worldwide.

## Get inspired by real world success stories

We’re proud to support the creation of better buildings. From hospitals to universities, offices to
entertainment venues, our gypsum wall, ceiling, and insulation solutions have met the needs of even
the most challenging projects.

performance, fire safety, and impact resistance, for our customers and their clients.

# Better sustainable materials start with Origin.

Origin is a leading technology company with a mission to enable the world’s transition to
sustainable materials. Origin has developed multiple sustainable and performance-enhanced solutions
for improving recycling and circularity, including its PET caps and closures.

[Origin PET Cap Aura]

Can your bottlecap do this? See what's possible with Origin PET caps.

so you can achieve your goals, for your products and applications.

# About Journal (Aims and Scope)

**In accordance with the Announcement of the Minister of Science of January 5, 2024 on the list of
scientific journals and peer-reviewed materials from international conferences, authors the
publication of scientific articles in the monthly „Materiały Budowlane” in the disciplines of: civil
engineering, geodesy and transport; architecture and urban planning; material engineering; chemical
engineering; mechanical engineering, as well as environmental engineering, mining and energy,
receive 100 points. **


**e-ISSN 2449-951X – The original version is the online in English/Polish
(ISSN 0137-2971 – The additional version is the paper in Polish/English). **

„Materialy Budowlane” is one of the oldest scientific journals in Poland (published since 1946),
addressed to all professional groups related to construction. It reaches designers and architects,
investors, contractors of construction and renovation works, producers and distributors of building
materials, representatives of state and local administration bodies, construction supervision
offices, construction research centers, construction and architecture departments of universities,
construction high schools, e.t.c.

The thematic scope of „Materialy Budowlane” includes mainly presentations of modern design,
technological and material solutions used in the construction, finishing and modernization of
buildings and engineering structures; the results of research carried out by scientists from Polish
and foreign universities and research institutes, as well as the latest achievements in the field of
construction. The monthly journal „Materialy Budowlane” is also a source of knowledge on changes and
interpretations of building regulations, and progress in the implementation of EU standardization,
prospects for the development of construction and individual sectors of the building materials
industry in Poland. Each issue contains many interesting articles, prepared by acclaimed authority
figures, in Poland and abroad, in various fields of construction. Due to improvement of journal
since July 2024 the original version is the online in English/Polish (e-ISSN 2449-951X) but the
paper in Polish/English (ISSN 0137-2971) has been kept as an additional one (ISSN 0137-2971).

**PUBLISHING PLAN**

„Materialy Budowlane” is published monthly (12 editions per year) in the last decade of a given
month.

High-level Political Forum on Sustainable Development
The High-level Political Forum on Sustainable Development (HLPF) is the central United Nations
platform for the follow-up and review of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and its 17
Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The 2026 HLPF will be convened from Tuesday, 7 July, to
Wednesday, 15 July 2026, under the auspices of the Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC). [HLPF in

Science, Technology and Innovation
Science, technology and innovation (STI) are essential for advancing the SDGs, enabling
evidence-based decision-making, accelerating implementation, and scaling solutions to complex global
challenges. On 6-7 May 2026, the eleventh annual Multi-Stakeholder Forum on Science, Technology and
Innovation for the SDGs (STI Forum) will take place at United Nations Headquarters in New York.
[2026 STI Forum][74] [2026 STI Solutions Book][75] [Technology Facilitation Mechanism][76]
Global Sustainable Development Report
The Global Sustainable Development Report (GSDR) is a United Nations publication aiming to
strengthen the science-policy interface, produced once every four years to inform the quadrennial
SDG review deliberations. The next report is scheduled for release in September 2027 ahead of the
High-level Political Forum on sustainable development to be held under the auspices of the General
Assembly (SDG Summit). [Global Sustainable Development Report][77] [GSDR in 2027][78] [GSDR in
2023][79]
Energy
Achieving SDG7 will open a new world of opportunities for millions of people through new economic
opportunities and jobs, empowered women, children and youth, better education and health, more
sustainable, equitable and inclusive communities, and greater protections from, and resilience to,
climate change. [Energy Compacts][80] [More on Energy][81]
Sustainable Transport
While there is no single dedicated Sustainable Development Goal for transport, it is reflected in
several SDG targets and recognized as an enabler for achieving many of the goals. The United Nations
Decade of Sustainable Transport will be an opportunity to further raise awareness of transport’s
crucial role in advancing the Sustainable Development Goals and to gather and rally new solutions,
resources and partnerships to advance sustainable transport globally. [UN Decade of Sustainable
Transport 2026 – 2035][82] [More on Sustainable Transport][83]
Water
Water is fundamental to sustainable development, underpinning health, food security, energy,
ecosystems, and economic growth. Ensuring universal access to safe drinking water and sanitation,
improving water quality, strengthening water management, and enhancing resilience to water-related
risks are essential for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and addressing climate change
impacts. The 2026 UN Water Conference will take place from 2–4 December 2026 in the United Arab
Emirates. Co-hosted by Senegal and the United Arab Emirates, the Conference aims to accelerate the
implementation of SDG 6 on clean water and sanitation, strengthen global water governance, and
further elevate water-related issues on the international agenda through concrete action and
partnerships. [2026 UN Water Conference][84] [More on Water and Sanitation][85]

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

### Refinity® – a seamless digital experience for bodyshops

Our cloud-based platform brings together a full suite of digital solutions for automotive refinish,
helping body shops worldwide work faster, more sustainably and with the most advanced digital color
experience available.
[Discover Refinity®][76]
[
Image

### Automotive Color Trends – DRIVING THE PROXY

Each year our designers shape the colors of tomorrow's vehicles. Our latest collection draws on
design, nature and technology, with sustainable materials and innovations like multi-color pigments
and liquid-metal surfaces.
[Explore the collection][78]
[
Image

### The world's largest color databases

Decades of color expertise, captured in one of the world's largest databases. It lets us match and
reproduce virtually any shade with precision, whether designing tomorrow's vehicles or restoring
today's.

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,
with over 130 years of refinish expertise, and R-M®, with more than a century of color leadership,
are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.

about the company

TECHNONICOL Corporation is a leading international producer of reliable and effective building
materials and systems. The company offers innovative products and technologies that combine
solutions of proper research centers and international experience.

The Corporation includes two large divisions, independently managed by each of the owners: the
TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, and the Trading Company "Technonicol
Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov.

The TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, integrates 70+ production sites in
Russia and abroad, 19 training centers and 7 research centers equipped with high-tech equipment and
qualified personnel. The centers regularly develop and implement new products and solutions for the
construction industry.

Trading Company "Technonicol Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov specializes in selling the
Corporation's products, but also other building materials and tools for industrial, civil and
private housing construction in more than 100 trade offices in Russia and the CIS.

The mission of TECHNONICOL is to produce high quality, reliable and effective construction materials
and solutions, which we strive to make available to every person in the world. Our team is guided by
principles of workmanship, high professionalism, responsibility and safety.

We are passionate about constant perfection of our materials, challenge met by our Research and
development centers. The company is constantly upgrading existing technologies and launching new
materials. Our Research centers and laboratories possess modern equipment to study physical and
mechanical properties of materials within a wide range of temperatures, define the structure and
ingredients of raw compounds and test the durability of finished products. Scientific research and
new technologies make it possible to launch several new products every year.

TECHNONICOL is among the first Russian companies to emphasize the need of educating builders in new
technologies and innovative material application. Our training centers offer modern equipment,
stands, models and spaces for hands-on training. Thanks to practical approach to learning, we give
additional educational support to our employees, customers and partners.

## Welcome to

# XUJUE ELECTRICAL

Xujue Electrical Insulation (formerly National Xuchang Insulation Materials Factory), Since 1958, is
a leading manufacturer specializing in the research, development,manufacturing, and sales of
electrical and electronic insulation materials for transformers, motors and related applications.
With an annual production capacity exceeding 30,000 tons, the company ranks among the top three in
domestic market share.

65+ years of manufacturing and R&D experience, operates 4 provincial-level R&D platforms, holds 48
national patents, and has participated in the development of 6 national standards.

## Our AI Lab & Showroom is officially open

On May 20, the BrainBox AI Trane Technologies AI Lab & Showroom opened in Montreal, Canada — a
permanent space designed to develop and demystify advanced artificial intelligence (AI) in HVAC.
Driving the frontier of AI and innovation, the AI Lab delivers cutting-edge solutions that
accelerate energy optimization and sustainability impact for our customers, communities, and the
built environment.

[Learn more about our AI Lab][131]

## Reimagining data center cooling for a more sustainable digital future

At Trane Technologies, we challenge the idea that data centers and sustainability are at odds and
can help redefine data center design through smarter cooling, energy management, digital solutions
and scalable thermal strategies. Our portfolio spans air cooling, liquid cooling and modular
infrastructure, backed by services that can improve resiliency through proactive monitoring,
predictive insights and maximized performance.

[Explore our data center solutions][132]

and strengthen resilience.

scales.

# Raw Materials Supplier USA

Bisley International deploys a holistic understanding of markets, technical insight and logistics
excellence to build durable strategies which unite the world’s best raw material producers with
industrial consumers in North America. We supply and distribute a wide range of specialty chemicals,
minerals, raw materials and more...

[About Us][55] [View Products][56]

WHAT WE DO

## Industry experts & the trusted chemical raw material supplier in the USA & Worldwide

Established in Houston, Texas, USA, Bisley International draws on the global reach of the
multinational Bisley Group, with 65 years of experience in marketing and as distributor of chemical
products and high quality industrial raw materials throughout Asia Pacific, Oceania and the Middle
East.

[Contact Sales][57] [Visit Bisley Group Australia][58]

As international raw materials and chemical suppliers, our products range from Fine Industrial
Chemicals for highly specialised applications, to bulk raw materials delivered in shiploads to major
regional manufacturers.

Our goal is to provide a complete package of technically outstanding products, supported by
proficient, responsive staff and first class logistics to a range of industries.

**Our Value Proposition**
We pride ourselves in our ability to add value and create synergies for our supplier and customer
partners.

**Our Guarantees**
We believe it’s important to focus on what is most valuable to our customers and really stand by
this - for the long term.

**Our strategic network…**
Our experienced team of logistics experts are able to track our cargo movements from factories
across the globe right to our customer’s doorstep, whilst keeping all stakeholders informed with up
to date information.

Bisley International is supported by the Bisley Group, with headquarters in Sydney, Australia.
Global chemical sourcing is also supported through our network of offices in the UAE, Bangkok,
Singapore, Malaysia, New Zealand, Indonesia and USA.

# nationwide wholesaler and distributor of select building and design materials

[Bedrock 11 home kitchen materials supplied by CP Supply]

CP Supply is a leading national wholesaler and distributor of building and design materials. We
supply a wide selection of thermally modified exterior wood cladding, designer interior wood siding,
energy-efficient windows, blinds and shades, real stone countertops and tile, ceramic and glass
tile, flooring, and much more. CP Supply provides customers with top-notch products that are both
ethical and sustainable. Our high-quality products come from leading innovative brands so that you
can trust the quality of what you are receiving.

We serve contractors, developers, designers, retailers, and architects across the U.S. Our mission
is to provide our customers with the highest quality materials while maintaining solid relationships
based on integrity and trustworthiness. As such, we offer competitive pricing and direct delivery
options – no matter the size or complexity of your order.

[CP Supply - unrivaled team support]

excellent communication with both our vendors and customers.

[CP Supply - quality assurance]

supplies that revolutionize industry standards is what we stand by.

we go above and beyond to ensure all orders are fulfilled quickly without compromising quality.

the best materials for their projects. CP Supply has become a trusted name in its industry by
delivering unparalleled service and ethics-driven sustainability practices. Connect with us today to
see how we can help your next building project succeed.

[Eco Packer]

Eco Packer is India's leading manufacturer and supplier of eco-friendly packaging materials,
headquartered in Bangalore. With state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities strategically located in
Bangalore, Chennai, Coimbatore, and Erode, we are committed to delivering sustainable packaging
solutions that meet the highest industry standards. Our extensive range of products is designed to
cater to diverse industries, ensuring that businesses can embrace environmentally responsible
practices without compromising on quality.

## Our Commitment to Sustainability

At Eco Packer, sustainability is at the core of everything we do. We believe that packaging should
protect not only the products but also the planet. Our eco-friendly packaging materials are designed
to reduce the environmental impact, minimize waste, and contribute to a circular economy. By
choosing Eco Packer, you are not only opting for high-quality packaging but also supporting a
greener future.

## Benefits of Our Eco-Friendly Packaging

Our eco-friendly packaging solutions offer a wide range of benefits, ensuring that your business can
maintain its commitment to sustainability without sacrificing performance:
* **Environmentally Safe:** Made from biodegradable and compostable materials, our packaging
  decomposes naturally, leaving no harmful residues.
* **High Durability:** Despite being eco-friendly, our packaging materials are designed to be strong
  and durable, providing excellent protection for your products.
* **Customizable Solutions:** We offer tailored packaging solutions to meet the unique needs of your
  business, whether it's for retail, e-commerce, or industrial applications.
* **Cost-Effective:** Our sustainable packaging is not only good for the environment but also
  cost-effective, helping you reduce waste management expenses.

## Applications of Our Packaging Solutions

Eco Packer's packaging materials are versatile and can be used across various industries. Whether
you are in food and beverage, retail, healthcare, or industrial sectors, our solutions are designed
to meet your specific needs:
* **Food & Beverage:** Keep your products fresh and safe with our food-grade biodegradable
  packaging.
* **Retail:** Enhance your brand's sustainability image with our compostable and recyclable retail
  packaging.
* **E-commerce:** Ensure your products reach customers in perfect condition with our durable and
  eco-friendly packaging for e-commerce.
* **Healthcare:** Protect sensitive medical supplies with our sterile and environmentally safe
  packaging options.

## State-of-the-Art Manufacturing Facilities

Eco Packer's cutting-edge manufacturing facilities in Bangalore, Chennai, Coimbatore, and Erode are
equipped with the latest technology to ensure the highest quality production. Our plants are
designed to maximize efficiency while minimizing environmental impact, using energy-efficient
processes and sustainable materials. This allows us to deliver top-notch packaging solutions while
reducing our carbon footprint.

## Why Choose Eco Packer?

Choosing Eco Packer means partnering with a company that prioritizes sustainability without
compromising on quality. Our commitment to innovation, combined with our extensive industry
expertise, makes us the ideal partner for businesses looking to make a positive environmental
impact. With our wide range of eco-friendly packaging options and customizable solutions, we are
here to help you meet your sustainability goals.

## Get in Touch with Us

Ready to make the switch to sustainable packaging? Contact Eco Packer today to learn more about our
products and services. Our team of experts is here to help you find the perfect packaging solutions
for your business. Together, we can build a greener future.

## Energy Efficiency Solutions Already Exist

They are affordable, scalable and ready for investment. Now is the moment to act.

**The Energy Efficiency Movement is the** **global network **driving** awareness, adoption and
development of energy efficiency solutions **across all industrial sectors.

The Energy Efficiency Movement empowers industry to adopt energy efficiency at scale and accelerate
progress toward net zero.

 

 

1/3

of the CO2 cuts we need can be delivered by energy efficiency.

Reference : IEA, 2024

We help companies move **from interest to action** by making energy efficiency knowledge,
implementation examples, training and partners easier to find and use.

For companies, energy efficiency can **lower operating costs, reduce exposure to energy price
****volatility, improve resilience** and cut emissions using solutions that already exist

By joining the Energy Efficiency Movement, **Movers** have a platform to **communicate** their
energy efficiency needs, **fostering** a collaborative environment that drives impactful change and
long-term **profitability**.

[Join now!][32]

15%

of the industry costs can be slashed through energy efficiency within two years.

Reference : IEA, 2024

## Why Should Your Company Join The Network?

LEARN

**Find practical guidance to identify energy efficiency opportunities, understand available
solutions and take the first steps toward implementation.**

[Shaking hands]

COLLABORATE

**Connect with organizations working on similar challenges, exchange implementation experience and
identify opportunities to accelerate action together.**

BUILD SKILLS

**Build the technical, operational and management capabilities needed to identify, implement and
maintain energy efficiency solutions.**

## Energy Efficiency Investment Report 2026

The 2026 edition of our survey shows that energy efficiency is no longer just a sustainability
topic: 98% of organizations are at least planning to invest in energy efficiency, driven by rising
energy costs and the need for greater resilience and competitiveness.

[Download report »][33]

### ****Celebrating 5 years of the Energy Efficiency Movement**

In this anniversary video, Linda Pålsson shares why collaboration, collective action, and energy
efficiency are more important than ever to build a resilient and competitive industrial future.

## About Fluor

Through our people, projects and partnerships, Fluor connects businesses and communities to advance
economies and employment. We create choice and opportunity on a local and global scale.

Building a better world is our purpose. We care deeply about safety and seek to drive quality and
efficiency in all that we do. We behave **ethically**, inclusively and responsibly for a brighter
future.

We support our clients in solving critical challenges. We operate throughout the project lifecycle,
from conceptual design, engineering, procurement and construction to the operations and maintenance
of facilities.

Clients, partners and communities trust Fluor because we are here for the long term – delivering
successful projects of both scale and significance for more than a century. From the spark of an
idea to a project's completion, our nearly 27,000 colleagues in more than 60 locations around the
globe provide professional and technical solutions with world-class expertise.

## Making connections since 1945.

**Fronius is a global corporation specializing in **welding technology, photovoltaics, and battery
charging technology.**

Since **1945**, we have been developing solutions that stand for **quality, reliability, and
durability.** With around 6,500 employees in **37 subsidiaries,** we focus on innovation and
sustainability in order to provide our customers around the world with the best possible products
and services.

Guided by the principle of “Connecting what matters”, we connect people, materials, and energy to
build a **safe and sustainable world.**

Fronius Solar & Energy
Electricity is the thread that binds our business and our world together. By focusing on energy
sector integration, our solutions connect the sun with the grid, the grid with mobility, and energy
systems with efficiency.
[Discover Fronius Solar & Energy][3]
Fronius Welding
Our welding technology is designed to forge unbreakable bonds between metals for decades to come.
[Discover Fronius Welding][4]

## Our new product highlights

### Reserva—the Fronius storage solution

Use solar energy around the clock with the Fronius Reserva. The high-voltage battery with DC
coupling ensures a highly efficient energy transfer. Thanks to its modular capacity of 6.3 to 15.8
kWh, the Reserva can be flexibly adapted to your needs. Designed to work seamlessly with Fronius
hybrid inverters, it slots perfectly into your PV system. Your data remains secure on European
servers, while our proven service and support network is always there for you.

[Learn more about the Fronius Reserva][7]
[Fronius Reserva]

### Fronius Fortis—the next-gen manual MIG/MAG welding machine

Welding tasks are often a challenge, especially for small and medium-sized companies. Some of the
tasks change on a daily basis, as do the required welding processes. This calls for a welding
machine that can be adapted perfectly to these dynamic conditions.

[Learn more about the Fronius Fortis][8]
[Fronius Fortis]

air sealing, lighting, and HVAC systems, we create holistic solutions that optimise energy use and
reduce environmental impact.

### Innovation Sustainability

The prevailing business environment in the world has made it imperative for the businesses and
startups to focus on innovation to gain an edge and advantage over their peer organizations in the
industry. With the ever-increasing cut-throat competition in various business spheres, it is
critical for both large scale organizations and startups to keep on bringing about innovations that
can sustain in the market. At the Institute of Advanced Materials, we help companies that want to
keep on developing and building on their innovation ability and quotient. We help organizations
develop sustaining innovations that help them bring about great results and impact in their
industry.

translational research & innovations in the sectors of energy, environment, health, and many more.

developments to ensure the transition of good quality of research into useful and significant
products for the end-user. IAM has maintained its materials science and technology outreach by

scientists around the world.

### Making Change That Matters

At Institute of Advanced Materials, we are committed to making change that actually matters for
society. We use our network of technocrats and researchers to recognize the areas that are crucial
for human existence along with the ones that hold true potential for development and enhancement.
All the work that we do, ranging from global consultancy, industrial training to research and
development is aimed at bringing out some positive change and making a significant difference to the
lives of people.

# What is IREC
# all about?
* Public research centre focused on advancing sustainable energy.
* Creating scientific knowledge with real technological impact.
* Driving the energy transition through research and innovation.

[Multidisciplinary research and innovation ecosystem focused on sustainable energy]

## Discover IREC

Learn who we are and how our research drives innovation in sustainable energy.

[See more][165]

## Who we are

IREC is a public research centre within the CERCA system, founded in 2008 and dedicated to research,
development, innovation and demonstration in sustainable energy.

Our work spans the full scope of the energy transition, from fundamental science to applied
research, with the aim of generating knowledge that is relevant to industry, public administrations
and society. Through collaboration with research groups, institutions and companies, we help drive
the energy transition and strengthen the role of science in building a cleaner and more resilient
future.

# Better sustainable materials start with Origin.

Origin is a leading technology company with a mission to enable the world’s transition to
sustainable materials. Origin has developed multiple sustainable and performance-enhanced solutions
for improving recycling and circularity, including its PET caps and closures.

## Origin stories.

[Origin PET Cap Aura]

Can your bottlecap do this? See what's possible with Origin PET caps.

[Watch >][37]
[Tethered Cap 900 x 900 px]

Origin offers the world's first and only tethered PET caps. For keeping caps connected to
containers.

[Read >][38]
[Reed City Mass Production Partnership]

[Read >][39]

### Meet the Origin CapFormer System.

The first and only commercial-scale manufacturing solution for PET caps.

### Innovative material solutions for everyday things.

We offer our customers versatile materials and intermediates, and expert guidance from our team. All
so you can achieve your goals, for your products and applications.

The best products deserve the best caps.
Origin's breakthrough PET caps and closures enables "mono-material” packaging solutions, improving
recycling and performance.

With rPET, Origin PET caps enable true container-to-container recycling.

# About Journal (Aims and Scope)

**In accordance with the Announcement of the Minister of Science of January 5, 2024 on the list of
scientific journals and peer-reviewed materials from international conferences, authors the
publication of scientific articles in the monthly „Materiały Budowlane” in the disciplines of: civil
engineering, geodesy and transport; architecture and urban planning; material engineering; chemical
engineering; mechanical engineering, as well as environmental engineering, mining and energy,
receive 100 points. **


**e-ISSN 2449-951X – The original version is the online in English/Polish
(ISSN 0137-2971 – The additional version is the paper in Polish/English). **

„Materialy Budowlane” is one of the oldest scientific journals in Poland (published since 1946),
addressed to all professional groups related to construction. It reaches designers and architects,
investors, contractors of construction and renovation works, producers and distributors of building
materials, representatives of state and local administration bodies, construction supervision
offices, construction research centers, construction and architecture departments of universities,
construction high schools, e.t.c.

The thematic scope of „Materialy Budowlane” includes mainly presentations of modern design,
technological and material solutions used in the construction, finishing and modernization of
buildings and engineering structures; the results of research carried out by scientists from Polish
and foreign universities and research institutes, as well as the latest achievements in the field of
construction. The monthly journal „Materialy Budowlane” is also a source of knowledge on changes and
interpretations of building regulations, and progress in the implementation of EU standardization,
prospects for the development of construction and individual sectors of the building materials
industry in Poland. Each issue contains many interesting articles, prepared by acclaimed authority
figures, in Poland and abroad, in various fields of construction. Due to improvement of journal
since July 2024 the original version is the online in English/Polish (e-ISSN 2449-951X) but the
paper in Polish/English (ISSN 0137-2971) has been kept as an additional one (ISSN 0137-2971).

**PUBLISHING PLAN**

„Materialy Budowlane” is published monthly (12 editions per year) in the last decade of a given
month.

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

## What defines us

Our intelligent coatings help customers shine in their markets. We anticipate global trends and
identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

Close collaboration, global presence, expertise and innovation are the pillars of our commercial
success.

Around 10,000 employees at our more than 70 sites of Surventis are ready to serve, wherever you are
located.

We engineer coatings and surface solutions, from treatment to refinish, across automotive and many
other industries. Working with us means going further to solve even your most challenging needs.

world moving.

about the company

TECHNONICOL Corporation is a leading international producer of reliable and effective building
materials and systems. The company offers innovative products and technologies that combine
solutions of proper research centers and international experience.

The Corporation includes two large divisions, independently managed by each of the owners: the
TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, and the Trading Company "Technonicol
Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov.

The TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, integrates 70+ production sites in
Russia and abroad, 19 training centers and 7 research centers equipped with high-tech equipment and
qualified personnel. The centers regularly develop and implement new products and solutions for the
construction industry.

Trading Company "Technonicol Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov specializes in selling the
Corporation's products, but also other building materials and tools for industrial, civil and
private housing construction in more than 100 trade offices in Russia and the CIS.

The mission of TECHNONICOL is to produce high quality, reliable and effective construction materials
and solutions, which we strive to make available to every person in the world. Our team is guided by
principles of workmanship, high professionalism, responsibility and safety.

We are passionate about constant perfection of our materials, challenge met by our Research and
development centers. The company is constantly upgrading existing technologies and launching new
materials. Our Research centers and laboratories possess modern equipment to study physical and
mechanical properties of materials within a wide range of temperatures, define the structure and
ingredients of raw compounds and test the durability of finished products. Scientific research and
new technologies make it possible to launch several new products every year.

TECHNONICOL is among the first Russian companies to emphasize the need of educating builders in new
technologies and innovative material application. Our training centers offer modern equipment,
stands, models and spaces for hands-on training. Thanks to practical approach to learning, we give
additional educational support to our employees, customers and partners.

about the company

TECHNONICOL Corporation is a leading international producer of reliable and effective building
materials and systems. The company offers innovative products and technologies that combine
solutions of proper research centers and international experience.

The Corporation includes two large divisions, independently managed by each of the owners: the
TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, and the Trading Company "Technonicol
Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov.

The TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, integrates 70+ production sites in
Russia and abroad, 19 training centers and 7 research centers equipped with high-tech equipment and
qualified personnel. The centers regularly develop and implement new products and solutions for the
construction industry.

Trading Company "Technonicol Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov specializes in selling the
Corporation's products, but also other building materials and tools for industrial, civil and
private housing construction in more than 100 trade offices in Russia and the CIS.

The mission of TECHNONICOL is to produce high quality, reliable and effective construction materials
and solutions, which we strive to make available to every person in the world. Our team is guided by
principles of workmanship, high professionalism, responsibility and safety.

We are passionate about constant perfection of our materials, challenge met by our Research and
development centers. The company is constantly upgrading existing technologies and launching new
materials. Our Research centers and laboratories possess modern equipment to study physical and
mechanical properties of materials within a wide range of temperatures, define the structure and
ingredients of raw compounds and test the durability of finished products. Scientific research and
new technologies make it possible to launch several new products every year.

TECHNONICOL is among the first Russian companies to emphasize the need of educating builders in new
technologies and innovative material application. Our training centers offer modern equipment,
stands, models and spaces for hands-on training. Thanks to practical approach to learning, we give
additional educational support to our employees, customers and partners.
